bio:
THE TEAR w/ 222glam

*Monthly*

Chad Garten, well known around Chicago as a dj/ 000bpm member/socialite, student of the ferocity & lover of sound, consistently bringing cinematic yet sick, twisted, banji  & belligerent ambience to every dj booth they have graced, for the 21 year old dj (222glam) dj sets serve not only as a catharsis but also as a means of understanding  of the self & the place they hold in the world surrounding them.

Frequently creating soundtracks that Command the audience throughout devote their bodies into their sonic universe of fierce destruction.

222glam wants you to feel your emotions & find beauty in the dread , as they present such neurotic sets that invite you into their dazey &disorienting, sensual— BADASS sonic universe of glamour & decay.
title: 222glam aka (bitchvariant)
